Key gaps: the note provides no imagery, no pre/post site plans or equipment inventories, no personnel numbers or roles, no precise dates/coordinates, and no explicit statement about whether any treaty-relevant equipment or functions were relocated to other sites or whether access/inspection arrangements have changed.
